note: What a server sends to tint a side's screens, or to take a tint away. The header carries zero.

fields.name: fadeIn
fields.note: Any value other than zero brings a tint in, and the colour and weight below follow; 0 takes it away, and they do not.

fields.name: time
fields.note: How long the change takes, in seconds.

fields.name: side
fields.note: Which side sees it: 0 for every client, or a side's number. A client with no player of its own shows a tint only for 0 and 100.

fields.name: colour
fields.note: The tint, as blue, green, red and opacity bytes.

fields.name: weight
fields.note: How strongly it applies at most.
